wrapping_procedure.round_trip_rule: wrap then unwrap must reproduce the portable payload bytes of the old rail; vendor-only remainder is queued, never dropped, and never stuffed into an opaque field. REPLACE is forbidden while the old rail still passes the differential.
steps: Load two real catalog units (IMP-0421, IMP-0422) as the sample.
Produce the old-rail artifact: MCP last-message via local CodexAdapter.build_plan (agentspec.argv); fan-out via import_fanout_path on per-unit profiles; agent-mail peer-receipt envelope.
Wrap with a6-common/v1 (portable unit_id/sentinel/body). Remainder keys are held, not forwarded.
Signal 1: sha256(portable old) vs wrap.payload_sha256. Signal 2: portable key-set vs wrap.payload keys. Disagreement is BLOCKED with both readings.
Both directions: unwrap(wrap(old)) must match portable(old).
Retirement of an old rail requires a removal record citing the passing differential run id and sha256 (awk-readable commit-message note). Uncited removal is refused.
wrapping_procedure.notes: A6 DESIGN.json is absent on this tree (ARC-0038 undelivered). tools/work-unit-adapters/codex.py and tools/import-adapters/codex_fanout.py are also absent (IMP-0161/IMP-0421 undelivered). This plan wraps the live agentspec.argv dispatch-safety rail and the agent-mail peer-receipt envelope. CodexAdapter does not spawn a live Codex binary; MCP artifacts are the last-message plan, not a cloud thread.

provenance_procedure.notes: Signal 1 is a payload digest. Signal 2 is a key-set (and, on the retirement probe, an awk Differential-Sha256 line). Neither mtime nor 'new rail is canonical' authorises dropping remainder or retiring the old path.

rollback.unit: keep the old rail in service; unwrap a6-common/v1 to the portable payload and continue dispatching on the original surface
steps: 1. Keep old-rail artifacts (MCP last-message, imported Workflow, peer-receipt) beside the wrap.
2. Attempting to retire an old rail without a cited differential sha256 must return RETIRE-WITHOUT-PROOF.
3. unwrap(wrap(old)) restores the portable payload; remainder stays queued rather than stuffed back as opaque_body.
4. Fire-and-forget profiles remain refused at import after rollback. Never replace a working refusal with a wrap that would succeed.
